Digestive Healthcare of Georgia is a leading provider of adult gastroenterology and hepatology services in the southeastern United States. With multiple locations in Atlanta, Fayetteville, Jasper, Newnan, Canton, and Ellijay, the clinic offers state-of-the-art equipment and specially trained nursing staff. With 17 physicians, they provide a full range of services, including consultations, procedures, and clinical research trials, offering the newest treatments available.
